{{Quote|You will, therefore, be taken to the Dune Sea and cast into the Pit of Carkoon, the nesting place of the all powerful Sarlacc.|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO's]] translation of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] words to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]|<ref name="Return">{{Film|VI}}</ref>}}
The '''Great Pit of Carkoon''', also called the '''Mouth of Sarlacc''' by [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]], was located within the [[Northern Dune Sea/Legends|Northern Dune Sea]] on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. The large depression in the sand was the home of a rapacious, if slow-eating, adult [[Sarlacc/Legends|sarlacc]]. Its [[Sentience/Legends|consciousness]] was merged to that of its ancient victim, [[Susejo]].

Its proximity to [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|Jabba's Palace]], paired with the torturous death provided by the sarlacc, made it an ideal spot for executions to be carried out for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] pleasure.

It was the place of the [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon]], and the subsequent death of Jabba.

==History==
{{Quote|Jabba takes his sail barge to the Great Pit of Carkoon to feed his enemies to the Sarlacc.|[[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Shock Rods|Tatooine}}</ref>}}
[[File:Carkoon_pit.png|thumb|left|250px|Luke Skywalker looks down into the maw of the sarlacc.]]
The sarlacc had resided in the Pit of Carkoon for around four thousand years by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A [[Choi (species)|Choi]] named [[Susejo]], who had fallen into the sarlacc by [[3996 BBY]], would eventually merge his personality with the beast as it remained stationary for millennia. At some point, the gang leader [[Alkhara/Legends|Alkhara]] had managed to cut a road from [[Jabba's Palace/Legends|his headquarters]] to the Pit of Carkoon before it was taken over by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] in the year [[516 BBY]]. Due to the pit being close to his palace, Jabba would begin using it as a means to execute people for his amusement over the course of many years.

After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the constant presence of [[Khetanna/Legends|Jabba's sail barge]] at the Great Pit of Carkoon had scared off the sarlacc's natural preys.<ref name="SWG:SR" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Jabba's [[Beastmaster/Legends|beast master]] [[Malakili/Legends|Malakili]] hired a spacer to kill [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland]] [[Eopie/Legends|eopies]] in order to collect their livers to feed the sarlacc.<ref name="SWG:SR" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Princess Leia]], and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] attempted to [[Siege of Jabba's Palace|rescue]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from Jabba the Hutt. After their capture, Jabba took his [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] to the pit, to be digested over years by the sarlacc. The prisoners, however, overcame their guards, with the help of [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]. While Luke, Han, Lando and Chewbacca [[Battle of the Great Pit of Carkoon|fought]] on their [[Skiff/Legends|Skiff]] and managed to knock [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] into the pit, Leia used the chains she was bound in to strangle Jabba. Luke subsequently destroyed Jabba's sail barge and escaped with the Rebels and the two droids R2-D2 and [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].<ref name="Return" />

Soon after that battle, [[Kuat (person)|Kuat of Kuat]], the leader of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], arranged a [[Bombing of the Dune Sea|bombing run]] of the area around the Great Pit of Carkoon to ensure the [[Death/Legends|death]] of the Boba Fett.<ref name="TMA">''[[The Mandalorian Armor]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Filming the Great Pit of Carkoon for [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Return of the Jedi'']] took place in the [[Yuma]] Desert in Arizona in April [[1982]]. The sound of the sarlacc was created from sounds of alligator hisses, as well as the sounds of some of the ''Jedi'' crew's stomachs after eating pizza.<ref name="Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away">{{SW|url=news/drawing-from-the-present-familiar-creatures-in-a-galaxy-far-far-away|text=Drawing from the Present: Familiar Creatures in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|int=Back from the Drawing Board|nolive=1}}</ref>

The Great Pit of Carkoon was originally supposed to be called the "Sloth Pit," but this was changed prior to the release of the script.<ref name="The Ultimate Return of the Jedi Insider's Guide">{{InsiderCite|67|The Ultimate Return of the Jedi Insider's Guide|The Ultimate ''Return of the Jedi'' Insider's Guide}}</ref>

The [[1997]] [[The Star Wars Trilogy Special Edition|Special Edition]] of ''Return of the Jedi'' added several tentacles and an extension with a beak-like tongue to the sarlacc.

While the original ''Return of the Jedi'' showed Boba Fett falling in the pit and then disappearing from view, leaving some freedom to [[Star Wars Legends|Expanded Universe]] authors to [[Retroactive continuity|retcon]] his escape, the Special Edition CGI beak-maw actually is shown to swallow Fett. However, this makes little difference, as the beak-tongue's insides are the same as those of the pit in general.

The [[W:c:swg:Pit of Carkoon|Pit of Carkoon]] appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> However, the game incorrectly identified the pit's location as the [[Western Dune Sea/Legends|Western Dune Sea]].<ref name="AED" />
